description: Minimal hardware decision matrix for 8 GB VRAM. Used by chenxin-core to gate model selection, quantization, and sampler choices before instantiating any model loader. Anything not in `allowed_quant` MUST be either downsized to fit or rejected outright; the default sampler pair is the safe default for diffusion-style distilled checkpoints on consumer GPUs.

notes.lightning_x2v: 8-step distilled LoRA on top of the native model; smallest VRAM cost at any resolution.
notes.lightx2v: Lightricks' distilled checkpoint; same recipe family as lightning_x2v but model-native.
notes.fcn: Fully Convolutional Network-style distilled controlnet/path; cheap, deterministic.
notes.native: Base model in fp8 or q8_0; always reachable but slower than distilled variants.

fallback_resolution.rationale: 768x512 keeps a 1.5:1 aspect with ~0.39 megapixels; well under the 8GB VRAM ceiling at q8_0 even for ~12B param models.
